1936, June
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 116 Cont.
June 1 Marie Feeley - 35 - anxious about exam to obtain ..... Fr. Kennedy - 44 - Expects operation To-morrow - family fears ... Rosemary Hines - Lydia Pacher - inner Goiter
Germain DeBacker - 15 - 25 June peculiar pains in stomach.
Page 117
June 13 Wesley Statler - 5% - when 3 had "staring unconscious spells" ... Enrolled Nov. 15th, '34 Shortly after enrollment in Nov. 15, '34 started to improve. Father Methodist raised in bigoted part of Canada has been deeply impressed by improvement in boy.
Eva R. Reace - 70 - (Erie, Mich.) losing sight. One eye blind - other dim .. .
Mrs. Anna Van Winkle - 53
18th Joseph Blazo - 18th - disobedient to parents - disrespectful .... En- rolled To-day - parents promising weekly Communion instead of less than monthly.
Helen DiMaggio 6 - peculiar threatening conditions with lung. Has wonderful faith for little child. When only 3 was in hospital for tonsel, wanted to be home for Christmas .... "God can cure me at home as well as here in hospital" ...
Ed. Arth. Colby - 18 - something Epil. Operation may be necessary
Page 118 June 18 Margaret Connors - 60 - non. C. - enemic - heart - ulcers in Head. Mrs. Martha Borski - 34 - dying of cancer - five small children Elizabeth Siebert - 46 - Lutheran - extremely nerveous
Page 119 June 20 T.McInerney - 49 - neglecting wife and children - drinking ... bad Comp'y.
